install_imagebind_package: install the imagebind python package using pip install from the setup.py configuration
build_imagebind_wheel: build a wheel distribution of the imagebind package using python setup.py bdist_wheel
install_imagebind_dev: install the imagebind package in editable development mode using pip install -e
check_imagebind_deps: check the install requirements for the imagebind package by reading requirements.txt
publish_imagebind: publish the imagebind package to a package index using python setup.py sdist upload
